problems.problem: The brief's signature device, the oblique blank celadon seam running parallel to the double-disc axis between slab edges, is absent: the three deterministic rectangles are pure axis-aligned steps with vertical/horizontal edges only, so no edge anywhere echoes the bottle's tilted disc axis. The concept reads as a generic stepped-stack graphic instead of its declared oblique logic.

The stair steps down left-to-right while the bottle's visual mass and its contact point (center_x 663, base_y 905) sit right of canvas center, so the composition's diagonal thrust and the product's weight both pull right and the upper-left celadon field (roughly x<250, y<250) stays empty; the ledger stair never counterweights the hero, unlike the resolved diagonal tension in reference R2's panel stack.

The plaque zone is only two text blocks and one hairline: the brief's 'section scale' idea is under-built, leaving a large inert celadon band between the decoration rule (y=1262) and the canvas bottom, so the lower third carries almost no graphic information compared with the dense slab field above.
